title: Give an existing data branch the .engram/.gitattributes line-ending rule that enablement promises
outcome: Give an existing data branch the .engram/.gitattributes line-ending rule that enablement promises
acceptance: A data branch created by data-init and exported to (as Engram's engram-data at b4f0025d) gains the documented '.engram/** text eol=lf' attribute through a supported step, or the docs say how an operator adds it
On a Windows checkout with core.autocrlf=true, staging a memory-including export no longer warns LF will be replaced by CRLF, and a no-op re-export after a fresh checkout leaves git status clean
